exceptionsReview.note: Every excepted diagnostic on the main checkout with file, line, reason, group and the recovered flagged expression text behind its digest.

limitations: Installed third-party code is not parsed. A registry package recorded in the committed package-lock.json is trusted not to construct product paths dynamically; only literal product identifiers (workspace name, products/<dir>) are caught by the byte tripwire.
Lock verification checks path, registry provenance, integrity field presence and package name; npm does not keep tarballs, so contents are not re-hashed against integrity.

Installed packages absent from the committed lockfile, or fake installs, are refused as INCOMPLETE (fail-closed) and are not parsed, so a product load hidden inside them is reported as unverified rather than as a FAIL with witness (10 critic probes changed FAIL/PASS -> INCOMPLETE).

169 first-party capability diagnostics on main are accepted through a restricted exception table authored by this lane (bound to file, reason, line text, full-expression digest and, for shutdown-signal-source, a pin on packages/shared/src/lifecycle.ts). --strict shows the raw INCOMPLETE result. The table requires independent review.

node_modules/source-map-js is installed at 1.2.1 while package-lock.json records 1.2.2 (stale install); reported as installedLockDrift, not a boundary path. `npm ci` was not run (shared tree, needs its own claim).
Gate results depend on the working tree: gitignored compiled mirrors (packages/*/src/**/*.js) and dist/ files reached by runtime resolution are analysed when present.
